samples.claim: DeepSizeOf is public. Its default deep_size_of adds size_of_val(self) to deep_size_of_children with a fresh Context; the latter is required and receives mutable traversal state. Separate top-level calls cannot deduplicate against each other. Implementations must count descendant heap storage without recounting their own inline footprint and should propagate the same context when deduplication is intended.
samples.review_note: Matches inline-size plus child traversal and a fresh Context per top-level call.
